import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp, torch.nn.functional as F
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT=str(29511+ws))
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=128, hidden_size=64, intermediate_size=128, num_hidden_layers=5, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    m = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref.load_state_dict(m.state_dict())
    ids = torch.randint(0,128,(4,16)); tg = torch.randint(0,128,(4,16))
    inp = list(ids.chunk(2)); tgt = list(tg.chunk(2))
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(m, inp, tgt, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    for i, t in zip(inp, tgt):
        lg = ref(input_ids=i).logits
        (F.cross_entropy(lg.reshape(-1,128), t.reshape(-1))/2).backward()
    md = 0; cnt = 0
    for (n,p),(_,q) in zip(m.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            cnt += 1; md = max(md, (p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(ws, rank, "loss", loss, "params with grad", cnt, "maxdiff", md)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__ == "__main__":
    for ws in (1,2): mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
